title: Affine closed-intersection comparison and the vertex contraction
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $A$ a sheaf of commutative rings on $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], and use module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] with inverse-image coefficient rings and the actual module inverse and direct images [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Use the canonical unit-normalized adjunctions [def-sfb-proetale-unit-normalized-adjunction]. Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ and $i_a:Z_a\hookrightarrow X$, $1\leq a\leq m$, be closed immersions [def-weil-closed-immersion], with each $i_a$ factoring through $i$. Let $M$ range over $A$-module sheaves. Assume their complementary open immersions [def-weil-open-immersion] are quasi-compact morphisms [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Assume $m\geq1$; no covering hypothesis is needed. For a nonempty subset $J\subseteq\{1,\ldots,m\}$ let $Z_J$ be the scheme-theoretic intersection (the iterated fibre product over $X$ [def-pc-fibre-product]), and put $E_J=i_{J,*}i_J^*$ and $E_Z=i_*i^*$. For $J\subseteq L$, let $r_{J,L}:E_J\to E_L$ be the actual unit of $Z_L\hookrightarrow Z_J$ pushed to $X$, with inverse-image composition identifications; define $r_{Z,J}$ similarly. Write $D^{-1}(M)=E_Z(M)$, $D^p(M)=\bigoplus_{|J|=p+1}E_J(M)$ for $0\leq p<m$, and $D^p=0$ otherwise. Use cochain complexes [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. The proposed differential is
$$ (dc)_{(a_0<\cdots<a_{p+1})}=\sum_{t=0}^{p+1}(-1)^t r_{L\setminus\{a_t\},L}(c_{L\setminus\{a_t\}}),\qquad d^{-1}=(r_{Z,\{a\}})_a. $$
Every $E_J$ and $E_Z$ is exact. Their units and restriction maps commute with open restriction through the canonical inverse-image identifications. Exactness of complexes of these module sheaves can be tested on any affine open cover of $X$.
Let $v:V\hookrightarrow X$ be any affine open, replace all the closed schemes by their fibre products with $V$, and denote the resulting augmented complex by $D_V(M|_V)$. For every $a$, applying $i_{a,V}^*$ to this augmented complex gives a contractible complex. More precisely closed base change identifies its summand at $J$ with direct image on $Z_a\times_XV$ from $Z_{J\cup\{a\}}\times_XV$ of the restricted module, and its degree $-1$ term with $i_{a,V}^*(M|_V)$. It identifies all face maps with the actual restriction units. If $a\notin J$, the restricted map $r_{J,J\cup\{a\}}$ is invertible. Define the component of $h^p$ from $J\cup\{a\}$ to $J$ by
$$(-1)^{\#\{b\in J:b<a\}}(i_{a,V}^*r_{J,J\cup\{a\}})^{-1},$$
and set the other components to zero; for $J=\varnothing$ use the singleton-$a$ component followed by the closed counit. Then $dh+hd=1$, including degrees $-1$ and $m-1$. Restriction of $D_V(M|_V)$ to $V\setminus |Z\times_XV|$ is zero. These identifications are linear over the inverse-image rings and natural in $M$.

proof.text: Apply the existing signed-refinement system to the given family. Its row, through lem-sfb-closed-intersection-row-from-signed, gives D. Outside degrees -1 through m-1 the finite-subset degree index is empty (cardinality is between 0 and m). Its product functor is zero by projection extensionality; evaluate and transport through D.terms to prove support.

Apply lem-sfb-closed-intersection-geometry. Each intersection is closed with quasi-compact complementary open, so proEtale_ringed_open_closed gives exact closed direct image. The immersion inverse-image limit-preservation theorem gives exact actual-ring inverse image. Compose these exact functors to obtain exactness of every term, including the empty index.

Open inverse image is exact by immersion limit preservation, hence preserves homology. Zariski-cover slice module detection detects zero homology for any ring sheaf. The ringed open comparison identifies actual open inverse image, after an equivalence of modules, with slice restriction. Thus acyclicity is equivalent to acyclicity on the given cover. The Lean helper proves this for every open cover; affineness is unused.

For any open g, apply lem-sfb-closed-intersection-open-comparison to get D_prime and its full unit-normalized compatibility. Geometry gives the original hypotheses for the pulled-back family. If Y is affine, apply lem-sfb-closed-intersection-affine-vertex to D_prime for each vertex.

For vanishing off the support, each intersection factors through the closed support by geometry. On a test object over the complementary open, its fibre product with that intersection is empty. The underlying abelian sheaf has zero sections there since the bottom sieve covers the empty object. This makes the slice restriction of each closed direct image zero. Transport across the ringed open comparison and reflect zero through its faithful equivalence, obtaining zero actual open inverse image of each intersection term. Evaluation and exact open inverse image preserve the finite product defining graded; the resulting limit cone has zero diagram and hence zero vertex. Transport through D_prime.terms to obtain zero for each row degree. No affine, compactness, or coefficient-flatness assumption is used in this last argument.

lean.statement: theorem closed_intersection_vertex_contraction {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (W : Fin m → Over X) (hclosed : ∀ a, IsClosedImmersion (W a).hom) (hfactor : ∀ a, Nonempty (W a ⟶ Over.mk i)) (hqc : ∃ U : X.Opens, Set.range U.ι = (Set.range i)ᶜ ∧ QuasiCompact U.ι) (hqcW : ∀ a, ∃ U : X.Opens, Set.range U.ι = (Set.range (W a).hom)ᶜ ∧ QuasiCompact U.ι) (A : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1}) : ∃ D : Row i W A, (∀ s, PreservesFiniteLimits (term i W A s) ∧ PreservesFiniteColimits (term i W A s)) ∧ (∀ (M : Modules A) (p : ℤ), p < -1 ∨ (m : ℤ) ≤ p → IsZero ((D.rows.obj M).X p)) ∧ (∀ (I : Type v) (V : I → X.Opens), (∀ b, IsAffineOpen (V b)) → (⋃ b, (V b : Set X)) = Set.univ → ∀ K : CochainComplex (Modules A) ℤ, K.Acyclic ↔ ∀ b, ((finiteClosedPullbackComplex (V b).ι A).obj K).Acyclic) ∧ ∀ {Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion g], ∃ D' : Row (pullback.fst g i) (finiteClosedPullbackFamily W g) (inverseRing g A), Nonempty (OpenCompatibility D g D') ∧ (IsAffine Y → (∀ a, Nonempty (VertexContraction D' a)) ∧ ∀ (U : Y.Opens), Set.range U.ι = (Set.range (pullback.fst g i))ᶜ → ∀ (M : Modules (inverseRing g A)) (p : ℤ), IsZero ((inverse U.ι (inverseRing g A)).obj ((D'.rows.obj M).X p)))
